description: Search the Massachusetts General Laws BY TOPIC or keyword when you do not have a chapter and section, e.g. "gold dealers", "fineness marks silver", "landlord security deposit". Matches the Legislature's own section titles and chapter names across all chapters (not statute text; the site has no text search). Returns chapter, section, title and the arguments to pass to ma_general_law for the full text. Optional chapter narrows to one chapter. Keyless.

chapter.description: Optional chapter to search within, e.g. "266" or "90A".

name: ma_search_sections

found.description: true when at least one section title matched

total_matched.description: All sections that matched before the limit

title: Ma Search Sections
